skills.name: AI/ML platform literacy
skills.description: Understands how models are trained, served, and integrated into products well enough to plan and unblock AI programs.

skills.name: LLM evaluation
skills.description: Defines and runs quality, safety, and regression evaluations for generative AI features before and after launch.

skills.name: Agentic AI workflows
skills.description: Plans and ships products where AI agents take multi-step actions with tools, including guardrails and human handoff.

skills.name: AI governance and safety
skills.description: Runs the policies, reviews, and documentation that keep AI systems compliant with internal standards and new AI regulation.

skills.name: Privacy and data protection
skills.description: Drives privacy-by-design, data mapping, consent, and regulatory programs such as GDPR and CCPA across products.

skills.name: Security and compliance
skills.description: Coordinates security reviews, certifications, and control frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP.

skills.name: Cloud infrastructure
skills.description: Plans programs on public cloud platforms, including migrations, regions, and capacity on AWS, GCP, or Azure.

skills.name: AI compute capacity planning
skills.description: Forecasts and secures GPU and accelerator capacity, data center power, and supply for AI training and inference.

skills.name: Data pipelines
skills.description: Coordinates the data ingestion, transformation, and quality work that analytics and ML products depend on.

skills.name: API and platform integration
skills.description: Drives integrations between internal platforms and external services through APIs, SDKs, and certification flows.

skills.name: Partner and ecosystem management
skills.description: Owns technical relationships with external partners, from onboarding and certification to launch and escalation.

skills.name: Observability and reliability
skills.description: Sets SLOs, incident processes, and monitoring so services and AI features stay reliable in production.

skills.name: Cost and FinOps
skills.description: Tracks and reduces infrastructure and AI inference cost through budgets, unit economics, and optimization programs.

skills.name: Edge and device platforms
skills.description: Ships software to consumer devices such as TVs, phones, and wearables, including on-device AI and release trains.

skills.name: Experimentation and metrics
skills.description: Defines success metrics and runs A/B tests to decide whether a launch actually moved the product.

skills.name: Release and launch management
skills.description: Runs launch readiness, staged rollouts, and go/no-go decisions across many teams and markets.

skills.name: Agile program execution
skills.description: Plans and tracks multi-team programs with roadmaps, dependencies, risks, and Agile or Scrum rituals.

skills.name: Cross-functional leadership
skills.description: Aligns engineering, product, legal, and business partners without direct authority and drives decisions to closure.

skills.name: Technical writing
skills.description: Writes clear design docs, program plans, and status reports that let leaders make decisions quickly.

skills.name: Web3 and blockchain platforms
skills.description: Builds or integrates blockchain, crypto wallet, and NFT platform features.
